Fixed a bug since 2022 that meant masks were being compared with the collider's layer number rather than the layer bit - even-numbered layers were always ignored (Default, Deployed, World, Bush, Tree). This meant that trees, ore nodes, junkpiles and more never blocked eachother from spawning, allowing overlaps.
